text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 白色颈部丝带。仅此单件配饰，成对耳饰或手套作为一组，无其他物品。
original_prompt: Standalone catalogue accessory photography: A single narrow white satin neck ribbon, choker-width, arranged loosely with two trailing ends. NOT a top, not a bra, no bodice, no cups, no clothing. Pure white seamless background, soft neutral studio light. ONLY the named accessory, entire object centered and uncropped. No people, skin, body parts, mannequin, other accessories or text. Reference collage is design inspiration only; ignore all clothes.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。文字图案以视觉参考为主，未逐图重生成验证。
